description: This file implements thermal modeling functions for the Cell_SPM class, including calculations for thermal surface, self-heating, environmental cooling, and coupled thermal interactions with neighboring cells. It defines methods for updating cell temperature based on internal heat generation and heat exchange with neighbors, and manages thermal state variables.

classes.name: Cell_SPM
classes.description: Represents a thermal model for a cell in the simulation, handling heat generation, environmental cooling, and interactions with neighboring cells.

methods.name: getThermalSurface
methods.description: Returns the thermal surface area of the cell, assumed to be the cell's surface area for heat transfer.

methods.name: thermalModel_cell
methods.description: Calculates the cell's temperature considering internal heat generation and convective cooling with the environment.

methods.name: thermalModel_coupled
methods.description: Calculates the cell's temperature considering heat exchange with neighboring cells and external environment.

methods.name: thermal_getTotalHeat
methods.description: Returns the total heat generated by the cell since start.

methods.name: thermalModel
methods.description: Main interface to update the cell's temperature based on selected thermal model type.
